Name: Roasted Veggie Plate
Author: novust
Description:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/bgxFR4WM/overview.png[/img]

It's pretty simple: A plate of yummy roasted vegetables, and the recipe to make it! 


[img]https://i.ibb.co/Y7FWbmvc/in-game-requirements.png[/img]

After your first house upgrade, the recipe and the meal itself should both be available at Gus' Saloon.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/1f42mVfk/installation.png[/img]

• Install the latest versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
• Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods. That's it!
• Safe to add to an existing save.
• To uninstall, simply delete it from your Mods folder. 


[img]https://i.ibb.co/Hpk9sGcQ/compatibility.png[/img]

Should be compatible with all mods, no matter how big, small, immersive, or simple.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/JwPPwY9F/translations.png[/img]

None yet. If you would like to translate my mod into a language you are fluent in, please let me know first, to avoid more than one person working on the same thing.

Once complete, you may upload it independently with my mod as a dependency, or send it to me to add here.

[b]Please no AI translations.[/b]


[img]https://i.ibb.co/gFvr0wMd/what-s-next.png[/img]

This mod is a practice mod, and therefore complete. But I do hope to make my own mods in the near future!


[img]https://i.ibb.co/bMq0frHX/credits-special-thanks.png[/img]

[b]ConcernedApe[/b] - For making this wonderful game, and encouraging modding♡♡♡
And especially [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/SiTheGreat1]SiTheGreat1[/url] - For their guide [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43811]Modder's Pie - A Complete Tutorial For Your First Mod[/url], for their extra help when I needed it, and for helping me realize that I [i]can[/i] make a mod.
